name: utlra-kuroneko
description: Greenfield agent stack (data plane + chat IR + inner runtime) — see ../doc/

scripts.build: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/server && npm run build -w @utlra/dashboard && npm run build -w @utlra/ops-console
scripts.build:chat-server: npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/chat-server
scripts.build:web-chat: npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/web-chat
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && concurrently -n server,dash -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @utlra/server" "npm run dev -w @utlra/dashboard"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run dev -w @utlra/server
scripts.dev:server:nowatch: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run dev:nowatch -w @utlra/server
scripts.dev:agent2: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run dev:agent2 -w @utlra/server
scripts.dev:gin: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run dev:gin -w @utlra/server
scripts.dev:aoi: npm run build -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run build -w @utlra/discord-bridge && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run dev:aoi -w @utlra/server
scripts.dev:chat-server: npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run dev -w @utlra/chat-server
scripts.dev:web-chat: npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run dev -w @utlra/web-chat
scripts.dev:webchat-all: npm run build -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && concurrently -n chat-server,web-chat -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @utlra/chat-server" "npm run dev -w @utlra/web-chat"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @utlra/chat-ir && npm run test -w @utlra/webchat-protocol && npm run test -w @utlra/webchat-bridge && npm run test -w @utlra/chat-server && npm run test:unit -w @utlra/server
